summary: This is a configuration for a pre-commit hook that runs 'prospector', a Python code analysis tool. When developers commit code, this hook will automatically execute prospector to check for code quality issues before the commit is allowed.

explanations.1: The 'repo: local' tells the pre-commit framework that this hook is defined locally in this project rather than pulled from a remote repository.
explanations.5: The 'entry: prospector' specifies the actual command that will be run—in this case, the prospector tool executable.
explanations.6: The 'language: system' means prospector should be run as a system command (assuming it's already installed on the developer's machine), rather than having pre-commit try to install it in a virtual environment.
